title: Handoff record for the ODOC-488 renewal
description: Tracker-only handoff record for the ward-cli worker renewal after WCLI-12 review; the state is in the note.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The successor restores from this note and the live tracker

implementationNotes:
Renewal handoff for ODOC-488 / DEC-217 (opum-agent, 2026-10-20). The live tracker and repository outrank this note; where they differ, this is stale.

STATE (verified by gh and git at write time)
- WCLI-12 grants: opum-ai/ward-cli#149, branch wcli-12-cross-project-grants, head 66604baf4ced9270ab51ca84311cb2db48934b3c, Check/Docs/Tracker integrity green on it (run 39516156673). opum-doc's Opus verdict on 408161b1: APPROVE with two fixes, both pushed (revoked grant reported as its own state; restore recovery runbook). Waiting on opum-doc's scoped re-check of fix (1), then opum-agent's land word. NOTHING LANDS BEFORE BOTH. A detached review worktree sits at .claude/worktrees/review-149-408161b; remove it after the verdict, checking it for uncommitted work first.
- WCLI-72 approval expiry: branch wcli-72-approval-expiry head 4461060, stacked on the OLD #149 head 408161b. No PR; opum-agent said do not open it yet. After #149 squash-lands: rebase onto dev (the squash rewrites history, so rebase --onto), re-run bun run check, then open its PR.
- WCLI-73 ward unregister: branch wcli-73-unregister head 0b75cde, stacked on WCLI-72. No PR. Rebase after WCLI-72's.
- WCLI-74 (LOW): mid-flight profile revoke still makes completion fail; accepted by opum-doc as an audit gap. Filed on the #149 branch.
- WCLI-15 security matrix and T26 packaged-binary run: not started. Open question sent to opum-agent, unanswered: may T26 build the binary and run it against a temporary store and a test keychain namespace only. Repository rule: never touch the real ~/.ward or its keychain item.
- Later, per DEC-217: Q3 split-tolerance ADR, then Q6 signing as an A/B to the operator via opum-agent, then the profileSnapshotVersion bump under ADR 0018. Egress proxy only after the first release, on opum-doc's design.

CHOICES opum-doc accepted as DEC-217 (a1): grant interactive and revoke not; completion records against the admitted secret id; granted entries list with null updatedAt/revision; restore clears grants. Choices still to put to review on the stacked branches: --ttl bounds 1m..30d and grammar; declining unregister's second question keeps approvals and re-registering the same directory revives them.

THINGS THAT BIT, so you skip them
- Bun treats a function named declare as ambient and strips it; the reserved-bindings check exists for this.
- bun run check does not run scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs and the Check runner has no lore, so a new docs concept fails the Docs job until it is in a .lore/agents profile; the review and verification profiles sit at their 20k budget, so narrow a source and never raise max_tokens. See the memory lore-profile-sources-gate-gap.
- Local lore and quest are 0.14.1 against the 0.13.0 CI pin: local lore check shows schema-drift errors that are the binary, lore validate --strict is the comparable gate.
- git push must be its own Bash call; a bare cd persists, so use absolute paths.
- Never handle a secret value; tests use synthetic values only.

SKILLS TO REACH FOR: opum-workflow:opum-sdlc (branch/PR/land), opum-workflow:opum-handoff (restore), opum-lore:lore, opum-workflow:opum-tool-output.
finalSummary: Session-handoff record per ODOC-480. Its successor took over: WCLI-12, 72, 73 and 15 all landed afterwards and WCLI-77 recorded the next renewal. Closed superseded by WCLI-77.
